title: Gratitude Journal: Coloring Book for Adults and Teens, Bold and Easy
subtitle: 50 Inspirational Designs with Positive Affirmations, Cozy Scenes, and Uplifting Illustrations for Mindfulness
description:
Color your way to a more grateful, peaceful, and joyful life.


This unique coloring book combines the calming practice of coloring with the power of gratitude and positive affirmations. Each page features a beautifully illustrated scene paired with an uplifting message — from cozy home moments and blooming gardens to sunrise landscapes and heartfelt quotes. The bold, easy-to-color designs create a meditative space where you can reflect on the good things in life while creating something beautiful.

What's Inside:
• 50 unique gratitude-themed illustrations with bold, easy-to-color outlines
• Positive affirmations and inspirational quotes woven into each design
• Cozy scenes — gardens, sunrises, tea time, candles, and peaceful nature moments
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Large 8.5 x 8.5 inch pages for comfortable coloring
• Perfect for colored pencils, markers, and gel pens

Perfect For:
• Daily mindfulness and gratitude practice
• A meaningful gift for anyone who needs encouragement
• Self-care and mental wellness coloring sessions
• All skill levels — beginners to experienced colorists

Pick up your colors and fill each page with thankfulness.
Every page is a reminder of the beauty in your life.
